Website operator

FordCargo.ro is operated by EKS LKW PIESE AUTO S.R.L., tax identification number RO36484785, Șoseaua Viilor 54, Bucharest 050152, Romania.

How enquiries work

The website presents parts for Ford trucks and lets you request a quotation. It has no cart, online payment or automatic contract formation. The form sends your enquiry by e-mail to the EKS LKW team; you can also send it via WhatsApp. Sending an enquiry does not mean that an order has been accepted and creates no automatic payment obligation.

Quotation and order

Compatibility is checked using the VIN, engine, variant and reference number. Price, applicable taxes, availability, shipping cost, payment method and timing are communicated in the individual quotation before order acceptance. The specific terms of a sale are confirmed separately.

Payment

Payment may be made by bank transfer/payment order (OP) or in cash, under the terms agreed when the order is confirmed. The website does not collect online payments or request card details.

References and trademarks

A catalogue reference or model listing alone does not confirm compatibility, genuine origin or stock. EKS LKW is an independent supplier; Ford, Cargo and F-MAX names identify applications and do not imply an authorised dealership.

Questions and complaints

Contact us with the enquiry or purchase details. Website information does not restrict applicable statutory rights.
